subject: P2b: Sweeps/loops/routes/dashboard enumerate workspaces explicitly
description: Phase 2b (see system note "SPEC: deprecate daemon global workspace pointer"). Depends on P2a's per-workspace cache. (1) Sweeps (sweepStaleClaims/sweepFailedTasks/sweepStaleVerdicts/sweepStaleGuidance) and the loop tick must iterate the real workspace set from workspaces.json (the loop tick already builds activeWsSet from active loops UNION state.workspace ~1173-1186 — drop the state.workspace union term, enumerate registered workspaces). (2) Route handlers in routes/{graph,overlay,meta,task,judge,analytics,exec,classify,label}.js that read state.workspace/state.overlay as a fallback must require an explicit workspace (use the per-request resolved ws, not the global). (3) Dashboard: routes/graph.js + public/graph.html must always carry an explicit ?workspace= — when absent, show a workspace picker / 400 rather than defaulting to the global. Use the fallback-seam list from P1's deliverable to ensure no caller is missed. Do NOT delete state.workspace itself yet (P3). Keep the full test suite green. Commit on the attempt branch.

summary: P2b done on orch/attempt/d7674989-1220-4c98-b891-80ca9e2e803b-3 (commit 50d3959). Added registeredWorkspaces() (daemon.js) reading workspaces.json UNION active-loop workspaces — NOT state.workspace. Switched 3 enumeration sites to it: the decideAll loop tick (dropped the state.workspace union term), the periodic claim-sweep interval, and the filedrop-stub-sweep interval. Dashboard (public/graph.html): added WS_RESOLVED gate + resolveExplicitWorkspace()/selectWorkspace()/showWorkspaceGate() so tick + tick_resilient never fetch /state until an explicit workspace is chosen (auto-select lone registered ws, else picker prompt) — no silent global default. New test registered-workspace-sweeps.test.js (13 assertions, all pass): enumeration excludes unregistered state.workspace + unions active loops + survives garbage registry; decideAll sweeps stale verdicts across MULTIPLE registered workspaces while an unregistered state.workspace verdict is NOT swept; dashboard HTML carries the gate. Seam checklist (note-mqi776tiyd5) accounted for: sweep callers feed the registered set; targetOverlay + per-seam warn fallbacks intentionally LEFT as P1 instrumentation (hard-400 + state.workspace removal are P3, per scope). Tests: full suite node scripts/run-tests.js = 157/167 pass; the 10 failures are the documented pre-existing Windows hook-path ones (orch-gate*, cursor*, codex-hooks, classify-hook*, dispatcher-model, judge-hook-nudge) — unchanged. Working tree clean. Did NOT merge.
